free_tier_limits: Free Current Weather & Forecasts: 60 calls/minute and 1,000,000 calls/month. One Call 3.0/4.0 separately: first 1,000 calls/day free (pay-per-call after).
resolution_notes: Auditor right on pricing.free_tier_limits. Official pricing (https://openweathermap.org/price) lists Free Weather API access (Current Weather, 5-day/3-hour forecast, etc.) as 60 calls/minute and 1,000,000 calls/month; One Call 4.0 is separate pay-per-call with first 1,000 calls/day free (FAQ: https://openweathermap.org/faq). Entry’s ~1,000/day conflated One Call with the free Current Weather APIs used in the example.
